description: This file defines a custom exception class 'ShortPasswordException' used when a password is shorter than the minimum length. It extends 'PasswordException' and provides constructors for default and custom messages.

classes.name: ShortPasswordException
classes.description: Custom exception indicating a password is too short, extending 'PasswordException'.

methods.name: ShortPasswordException()
methods.description: Default constructor that initializes the exception with a standard message indicating a short password.

methods.name: ShortPasswordException(String message)
methods.description: Constructor allowing a custom message to be set for the exception.
